input_contract: Read-only H2-pro_dynamic_window_v1; 2000 observed events, 25ms closed tick, max100ms; count normalization before log compression; original physical history retained
proposal: Original frozen H2-pro ANN Proposal weights, threshold0.51, all current and anchor inference accounted; no optimizer parameters
refiner: Original trained H2-pro-C1 seed42 epoch10 float checkpoint; 36->64->32->4 bias-free, original old/new first-layer partition and max-of-two prototypes per class
initial_state: Both arms restore one shared initial model, fresh AdamW and Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA random states; no warmup or newly initialized weights
training: Full FP32 supervised cross entropy (same two-class objective as original softmax BCE), all original Refiner matrices trainable; no KD, QAT, hard mining, clipping, AC regularization or amplitude stop
budget: Five full Main epochs per arm; identical shuffled source-event order and source-event batch boundaries, identical optimizer step count; each arm's complete candidate set visited once per epoch. Candidate counts and actual FLOPs can differ. No candidate thinning or repeated oversampling to equalize counts.
export: Original ANN quantize_weight: per-output absmax/127 and round-to-even int8. Scales follow learned weights; not fixed to the original range.
evaluation: Epoch0 and every epoch: full Dev float and exact exported-int8, fixed event threshold0.35, all original closed-prefix events including Proposal rejects, original sequence HD>=20000events/s
selection: Dev int8 full-event IoU, ties by recall; epoch0 eligible; all epoch weights/Adam/RNG/export/predictions/metrics retained
data_acceleration: Precompute both policies' full uint8 candidate features; verify against prior full inference; one arm's Main/Dev tensors and source-to-candidate map resident on GPU; deterministic GPU permutation once per epoch; no per-batch disk loading or CPU feature calculation
resumption: Atomic last checkpoint every10 committed updates by default; Ctrl+C or suite PAUSE requests a safe boundary checkpoint and stops the whole suite. Hard-killed processes resume last committed batch. Preserve every epoch full state. OS-owned lock prevents duplicate writers.
cost: Unchanged frozen Proposal current/anchor MAC plus4480MAC per candidate; both zero-skip and dense Proposal conventions, AC0. Training compute/host memoization/scalar/feature/control/memory work not deployment energy.
training_start: User only. Preparation/preflight may infer and backpropagate real data without optimizer steps; update/resume tests use synthetic data only.
